# Linkhut

LinkHut manages bookmarked links in a minimalistic, shareable interface, helping teams organize URLs and track references in one place

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/linkhut/.

## Actions

- **Add bookmark**: Adds a new bookmark to linkhut.
- **Delete bookmark**: This tool allows users to delete a bookmark from their linkhut account by providing the bookmark url.
- **Get all tags** (read-only): Retrieves a list of all tags and their usage counts for the authenticated user.
- **Get bookmarks** (read-only): This tool retrieves all bookmarks from the user's linkhut account.
- **Update Bookmark**: This tool allows users to update an existing bookmark in linkhut.
